artworks.title: American Landscape
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection) and Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund

artworks.title: The Booby (Pelecanus Sula)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird standing on a rock by the sea. The bird has dark brown plumage and webbed feet. The painting shows a high level of detail in the bird's feathers and beak. To the left is a faint outline of the bird's head. In the background, there is an expanse of water with a distant ship. The rock the bird is on is depicted with earthy tones. Text underneath the bird labels it as "The Booby" and provides a Latin description.

artworks.title: The Cutwater (Rhynchops nigra)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird in profile, standing on ground. The bird has distinct coloration, with dark plumage on its back, wings, and tail, and lighter color on its underbelly and face. It has long, slender legs with webbed feet, and an elongated, forked beak that is open. The beak shows a reddish-orange hue at the upper section and black tips. The drawing depicts detailed feathers, legs, and feet texture, with a minimal background.

artworks.title: Monsieur... voici ce que nous donnons... en prime...
artworks.description: Two men and a child are depicted in the image. One man gestures towards a pile of papers and books, with an open mouth. The other man wears a tall hat and stands with his back to the viewer. The child, wearing a cap and dark clothing, points upwards towards the pile. The background contains a bookcase full of items, including musical instruments, books, and loose pages. The wall displays the text "L'UNIVERS MUSICAL."

artworks.title: Les troupes Austro-Prussiennes entrant a Hambourg ... [top half]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring military troops and a crowd near a coastline. The illustration depicts a large group of mounted troops moving, with a large tower structure on the left and dockside posts to the right. The scene is busy, with many individuals on foot interacting. Children and adults are present, observing and accompanying the mounted figures, adding to the dynamic energy of the scene. The drawing has detailed line work typical of 19th-century illustrated periodicals, capturing the social and historical context of a military event with depth.

artworks.title: Interieur d'un omnibus [bottom half]
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals seated in an enclosed vehicle, likely an omnibus. Most of the people are visible from the waist up, except for the standing individual on the left. This person stands to the side, holding onto a vertical pole. To their right, a seated woman cradles a baby. Next to them sits a man with a stocky build, followed by a woman with a distinctive profile. The final man in the lineup wears a tall top hat and appears to be leaning with eyes closed. They are dressed in 19th-century attire. The background features minimal details of window frames or panels, suggesting they are inside a transportation vehicle.

artworks.title: Train de plaisir
artworks.description: The image shows four people seated closely together, visible from the chest up, in an enclosed carriage or compartment. They are positioned side by side, facing forward, and huddled closely. The first person on the left has their head slightly tilted down with features partially obscured by a headscarf and coat. The second person has a solemn expression, with prominent facial lines, wearing a high top hat, and a thick, high-collared coat. The third person is wearing a hat with a slightly frilled edge, has drooping facial features, and is draped in thick clothing. The fourth person on the right, like the second, wears a top hat and has their face partially covered by a scarf or coat collar. All individuals seem wrapped in heavy garments and bundled blankets. The background depicts a texture resembling paneling or a wooden wall, with a bright area in the upper right, possibly representing a window letting in light or showing the exterior environment.

artworks.title: Woodland Pond with a Fisherman
artworks.medium: black chalk with pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image features a detailed landscape drawing from a slightly elevated point of view showcasing a natural scene filled with dense woodland. The horizon is not distinctly demarcated, suggesting the presence of distant tree lines blending into the sky. The brushstrokes are intricate, utilizing fine lines and hatching to convey texture in the foliage and trees, and to define the landscape's elements. The color palette is primarily composed of monochromatic earthy tones, with shades of tan and gray dominating the scene. Close to us, the scene is populated by detailed, large trees with swirling branches. Beyond these trees, the drawing continues to depict a rich forest environment, gradually becoming less distinct in the background. Hints of wildlife, like birds in flight, are present in the sky, adding movement to the setting.

artworks.title: Landscape with Sleeping Peasants
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a detailed tree in the center, hills, and distant trees in the background. The brush strokes give texture to the scene. The color scheme is primarily sepia. Near the bottom left, there is a bush and a round object. The landscape extends towards the horizon, where more trees are visible against the sky.

artworks.title: The Prison Visit
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of masked figures in a historical setting. The image shows an assembly of masked or costumed figures in an architectural environment featuring a staircase, brick walls, and a series of grid-like windows. The background includes arches and columns, with a texture suggesting a mix of stone and brickwork. The figures are engaged in various activities, some standing, gesturing, or interacting with each other, creating an air of festivity or mystery. The drawing uses sepia tones, contributing to an aged, classical effect reminiscent of sketches from a historical era.

artworks.title: Punchinello's Farewell to Venice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people near waterfront architecture. They are wearing long white robes and conical hats and appear to be engaged in conversation or celebration. There are gondolas, grand buildings, and a canal in the background. The scene includes a tile-patterned pavement and a dog observing from the side. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Tiepolo, known for dynamic compositions with architectural elements.

artworks.title: Herdsman Crossing a River
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Jacob Zeitlin
artworks.description: The scene shows a group of cattle and sheep being herded across a shallow stream. A shepherd leads the animals with a stick, while two cows are at the forefront. In the background, there are rolling plains, sparse vegetation, and ruined buildings on a hill. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, and the color palette consists of earthy browns, warm grays, and creamy whites.

artworks.title: Lake George
artworks.medium: graphite and white gouache on cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is near the top, with hills meeting clouds. A lake is visible, and a path with a basket and wooden debris is on the foreground. Bushes, trees, and tall slender trees are depicted in the distance. The sky has white clouds. The color scheme includes earthy tones and highlights with a technique of pencil strokes and white accents.

artworks.title: Venetian Lace Making
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in profile view next to a spinning wheel. The individual's full body is visible, from head to toe, wearing a dress-like garment. They have a softly rendered facial expression and close-to-the-head hair. An empty chair is beside them, and the background is undefined on textured paper. The scene lacks environmental details, with annotations at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Fifth Avenue Building from Grace Church
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a city street with busy activity. People and horse-drawn carriages fill the street. A tall spire is visible in the distance. The architecture on each side of the street is detailed with pencil strokes. The drawing style is sketch-like with flowing lines. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray, emphasizing the simplicity of the pencil work. In the distance, building outlines become less distinct, guiding the eye towards the central spire.

artworks.title: Fishing Boats and Shack
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting a coastal area. The view is from a slightly elevated position, focusing on the waterfront and structures. In the background, there are faint outlines of sailboats on the water, with a distant landscape visible. The sketch is detailed with soft pencil strokes, showing small boats on the sandy shore near a pier, a wooden house, and dock equipment. The color palette is various shades of gray, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Maine Coast
artworks.medium: graphite and gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky coastline with jagged rocks and cliffs spreading from left to center, then sloping downwards to the sea. The horizon is faintly visible with low clouds in the sky. The sketch uses fine brushstrokes and pencil lines on tan paper to depict the shoreline and waves. The color palette is muted with shades of brown and gray. Close rocks are seen in various orientations, and some trees are on a cliff in the distance.

artworks.title: An Omen of Augustus's Future Greatness
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.9 × 26.7 cm (7 13/16 × 10 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: A drawing of a mythological scene with classical architecture and figures. The image features several figures in ancient attire engaged in various activities within a landscape setting. One figure rides a chariot drawn by horses amidst clouds in the sky. On the ground, there is a gathering of individuals around a bathing scene. Classical architecture, including columns and a domed structure, is present in the background. The detailed renderings of trees, buildings, and figures showcase a meticulous and skillful artistic approach.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child Trampling on Sin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman and a child. The woman is behind the child, gently supporting the child's upper arms. The woman has soft facial features and her hair is partially covered with a headscarf. She wears a draped garment. The child stands in front with arms outstretched, has curly hair, and is unclothed. There is an architectural element resembling a column or plinth to the right, with a piece of fabric draped over it. In the background, there is a textured pattern suggestive of trees or bushes against a lined sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with Travelers
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from an elevated angle, with trees, mountains, and a river. The artwork is detailed with fine lines creating texture and depth, using a monochrome color palette of black, gray, and white. Two figures are shown on a path through a forest, with a river flowing towards mountains in the distance, set against a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: George Duke of Buckingham with his Brother Francis
artworks.artist: James MacArdell after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows two young boys depicted from head to toe, both standing upright in a formal portrait. The boy on the left has wavy, shoulder-length hair, with delicate features and a slight smile. He is wearing a satin ensemble with a fitted doublet, slashed sleeves, and short knee-length breeches, accessorized with a lace collar. His hand is on his hip, while the other hand is not clearly visible due to the voluminous draped fabric of his attire, including a long cape-like garment. The boy on the right has similar facial features with straight hair falling around his face. He wears a satin outfit with a lace collar, and his hand is resting on his midsection with a draped fabric falling at his side. Both boys have embroidered shoes and stand in front of a backdrop showing a draped curtain on the left and a hint of landscape with trees to the right, conveying a sense of depth and formality typical of classical portraiture.

artworks.title: Nocturnal Landscape with River Fishermen outside City Walls
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape with architectural elements, foliage, and figures. In the middle distance, a figure stands on a bridge near a bright light. The artwork features intricate line work and etching, creating a textured surface. The color palette is predominantly brown. Closest to the viewer, two figures stand on a boat, with one holding a torch. Surrounding them are lush vegetation and a river. Further back, there is an arched bridge and distant buildings or castles. The scene conveys a serene yet active atmosphere.

artworks.title: Giacomo Antonio Mannini
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper torso and head of a person at an angle, facing slightly to the right. The individual has closely cropped curly hair, distinct facial features, and a neutral expression. They wear a garment with an ornate, double-layered collar fastened with buttons. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, highlighting the subject in the foreground.

artworks.title: Cows at a Watering Place (Vaches a l'abreuvoir)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated point of view, focusing on the horizon line above the center of the composition. The horizon is marked by light breaking through a cloudy sky, reflecting on the water below. The scene features intricate brushstrokes creating textures in the foliage and clouds. The color palette consists of muted sepia tones. Water fills the lower part of the scene, reflecting trees and sky. In the distance, a series of trees blend with the textured sky. The composition is rich with depth and nuance.
